verdict.rationale: GitHub documents GitHub Actions as a way to automate and run software development workflows in the repository with CI/CD. It also ships an official GitHub CLI that brings Actions, PRs and issues to the terminal, REST and GraphQL APIs for automating workflows, fine-grained tokens for programmatic access, and a Copilot CLI usable from the terminal. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of non-interactive/headless Copilot CLI or agent invocation inside CI pipelines, token-based non-interactive gh auth in CI (only interactive `gh auth login` is shown), and independent hands-on corroboration.
